<function name="SelectMaterial" parent="MatSelect" type="panelfunc">
	<description>
<internal>Use <page>MatSelect:FindAndSelectMaterial</page> instead.</internal>

		<arg name="mat" type="DImageButton">The material to select, found by <page>MatSelect:FindMaterialByValue</page></arg>
	</args>
</function>
